nodes.text: Self-diffusion coefficient of liquid Si at 2500K can be calculated via MD with SW potential, NPT heating 300K→2500K at 2.2 K/ps, 500 ps equilibration, then MSD/Einstein relation

support.quote:
The task requires:
1. Start from crystalline silicon structure (mp-149)
2. Replicate 3 times in each direction
3. Use Stillinger-Weber potential
4. Heat from 300K to 2500K at 2.2 K/ps under NPT (zero pressure)
5. Equilibrate liquid for 500 ps at 2500K
6. Calculate diffusion coefficient from MSD using Einstein relation
7. Report in m²/s

hypothesis.canonical: Self-diffusion coefficient of liquid Si at 2500K obtainable via SW-potential NPT MD with Einstein/MSD relation
